billing.notes: billing_minutes = runtime minutes x runner multiplier, at base_rate_usd per billing minute. Appending ";scheduling=flex" to a runs-on label bills at 0.6x (see scheduling_discounts). Per-job rounding behaviour not yet verified. Runner specs and labels: https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-runners/overview

free_tier.notes: A startup program offers 50% off plus free minutes; not applied in runnerdb prices.

notes: Public and private repositories are billed alike.
